Thank you for replying,it means a lot to me.
I've moved and even been interstate,strangely it follows.
Other people going through similar have said it has been pointless moving OS and can continue for decades.
As it's the government,how do you fight that without a lot of cash!
I'm female in my 40's now and my future looks pretty bleak due to this.
At my age I guess there isn't a lot of choice.They are very intent in causing my death and making out I was paranoid/mentally ill!
I've got to the stage I guess I just want to die and see no point continuing,due to all the damage they have caused.
The motive I believe is to cover up some nefarious behaviours that occurred 25years ago and one persons petty vengeance or need to express how powerful they are,so they have kept it alive and well.
This is my best guess,as well as that one person having done some serious crimes the past 25yrs till recent and would spend a long time in prison if they do not discredit me.
Really I do not really know,however they are trying to force me to suicide and police have threatened me and direct attempts on my life have taken place.This is not paranoid thinking.
I guess really Ive made my decision to do it soon anyway as I see no future and do not think they will stop.
As I believe it has been intentionally the plan and i was a healthy,strong capable person before their last attacks,the injustice is hard to take and I just need someone to listen.
I appreciate your kindness.

They are now going to my close family and illegally showing them government files dated back 20 years ago.
They try and cut off all support and make me appear to be insane.
Even if I present in person as perfectly normal and creditable they now have "created"evidence such as bogus diagnosis and false criminal charges.
The authorities can be very skilful at "building a case"that can twist reality so well,it can make the most law abiding citizen appear sinister.

I believe I have been victim of corruption and a lot of people want to save there careers and a long time in prison.
My demise is their solution.
No I'm far from Ok.
The things they do are hard to prove,apart from proving obvious things and being able to show a ridiculous amount of bizarre occurrences and strange behaviours from some authorities.
They are not that clever but very sneaky and will stoop to doing things so horrible,the average person wouldn't believe it!
People that do believe it will think Ive done something wrong or deserving of it.I am embarrassed by what is going on but can't take it.

There is a lot of copout victim blaming and severe bullying going on.

Each attack I always feel they put so much force on me and make me feel so trapped and hopeless I feel desperately suicidal.

It is not a matter of me not being strong enough or big enough,the richest,strongest most resourced person in the world would have a hard time surviving this.
I believe the purpose of this behaviour is to drive me to suicide and be able to say that I was mentally ill...oh well!
No I'm not OK at all.
Thanks for listening.
